title: 基于共识的大语言模型相对偏好评估框架
summary: 提出一种基于共识的评估框架，通过多模型投票和相对偏好排序（RII指数）替代传统绝对正确性评估，适用于多有效答案场景。实验表明模型间偏好一致，可作为代理信号。
summary_en: Introduces a consensus-based evaluation framework using multi-model voting and Relative Intelligence Index (RII) to replace absolute correctness, suitable for scenarios with multiple valid answers. Experiments show consistent inter-model preferences as a proxy signal.
